about: Dial label placement fixture (weewx-celestial 9.8): real skies computed by weewx-skyfield, each with its az/alt/earth_distance deltas over the 600 s before it (prev), so the page derives rates and draws its trails.  Comets halley and hale_bopp.  palo-alto: the 20 skies where 9.7.2 misattributed most names on a phone, plus five the design reviews inspected.  proxima-diagonal and proxima-east-west: Proxima set to the rim directions where the frame check bites (20-unit type on the narrow frame; the wide frame).  sydney: every tenth Sydney sky.
